faqs.question: Is this the official SRMIST website?
faqs.answer: No. This is an unofficial redesign concept for the SRM Website Design Challenge. Always confirm details on the official SRMIST website.

faqs.question: Where do I submit my application?
faqs.answer: Applications are made on the official portals only: applications.srmist.edu.in for India and intlapplications.srmist.edu.in for international applicants. This concept site has no application form or tracking.

faqs.question: Which admissions phone line should I call?
faqs.answer: Engineering, Agriculture and Architecture: +91 70 2645 2645. Liberal Arts & Business Studies, Law, Management, Medical & Allied Health and Hotel Management: +91 70 2647 2647.

faqs.question: Where can I read about scholarships?
faqs.answer: The official scholarships page for India (Engineering) has the details. This site does not list scholarship amounts or criteria.

faqs.question: Where can I find fees, eligibility and intake for a programme?
faqs.answer: Open the programme on the official programme finder and use the figures printed there. Values on this site marked placeholder are not confirmed.
